# Block `prose`

**Use:** Short explanatory text (at most 80 words) that connects the other blocks.

**Avoid:** Lists of facts, comparisons or sequences — use list, table, steps or timeline instead.

## Example

```json
{
  "kind": "prose",
  "md": "An **index** is a separate structure that maps key values to row locations, so a lookup does not scan the whole table.",
  "source": [
    {
      "file": "slides.pdf",
      "page": 4
    }
  ]
}
```

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"prose"` | yes |
| `source` | array of object (1–5) | no |
| `source[].file` | string | yes |
| `source[].page` | integer (≤ 9007199254740991) | yes |
| `md` | string | yes |

Every block may carry `source`: 1–5 `{ "file", "page" }` references to the material it came from.
